object:iron chain.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thick nearly black chain forming an open bent loop, with several large squared links. The teal pattern is background.
object:iron chain.wikiDescription: An iron chain is a separate NetHack object that can connect to a heavy iron ball. The tile shows only linked chain, not the ball.
object:iron chain.modelBrief: Build a short freely curved chain of large dark iron links, leaving open gaps between the loops. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:splash of venom / splash of blind.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a suspended cluster of magenta and pink liquid droplets, with one large center splash and several smaller beads. The teal pattern is background.
object:splash of venom / splash of blind.wikiDescription: The wiki describes blinding venom as a liquid projectile that splashes over a target's face. Both venom types have a generic splash appearance, while the visible pink palette comes from PixelHack.
object:splash of venom / splash of blind.modelBrief: Build a frozen splash of pink-magenta fluid with one broad central lobe and separated small droplets; avoid a bottle or solid stone. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:splash of venom / splash of acid.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a suspended cluster of olive-yellow liquid droplets, with a pale central splash and several smaller beads. The teal pattern is background.
object:splash of venom / splash of acid.wikiDescription: The wiki describes acid venom as a liquid projectile that deals acid damage. It shares a generic splash appearance with blinding venom; this tile uses a distinct yellow-green palette.
object:splash of venom / splash of acid.modelBrief: Build a frozen splash of yellow-olive acidic fluid with a broad central lobe and separate droplets; match the pink venom silhouette without merging palettes. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.
